about: What an enemy leaves when it dies (creator, 2026-11-11: "when the trooper explod they alwa have plooms of smoke in their color variant and a sould will arise ... if you shoot you will gain 5 currency ... soould ord disappear after 5 scond and if you dont destroy them you dont get the money"; docs/11). One row per drop. enemies: the enemies.json rows that leave it. gold: money the player who breaks the orb gets (flat; creator: "Always 5"; only that player: "The player who broke it"). lifetime: seconds before an unbroken orb vanishes (no money). rise / riseTime: the orb appears in the enemy's chest and drifts up rise metres over riseTime seconds, leaving a dark smoky trail (creator: "Rise from the chest, slow"; "it should rise slowly from the enemy after death", with a picture of Deadlock's: teal-green glow, dark core, dark trail), then hovers; radius: the orb's size in metres (its shell; head-sized, creator: "they are quite small around the size of a head"); the hurtbox is 1.5x that, so it stays fair to hit. orbTexture / glowTexture: Deadlock's soul orb colour and self-illum maps (generic_soul_orb), read from the creator's own rip folder glowFolder (dealockRip/props/souls: creator's choice, 2026-11-12, "Use dealockRip/props/souls"; never the Deadlock install: "do not steal anything that isnt mine"). shellTexture: generic_soul_orb_shell's voronoi noise (white, the cells in its alpha), cut out and scrolling around the core as in Deadlock. orbColor: its colour (Deadlock sets it in the last_hit particle effect, which isn't in the creator's files: tune it here). breakSound / missSound: RoR2's own sound events (played by name from the game being modded, nothing copied: the creator's files have no orb sounds; replace them with theirs when they have some). smokeTexture: the death smoke's puff, from the enemy's own rip; smokeColors: one per look in enemies.json models order (amber, sapphire); smokePuffs: puffs per death; smokeTime: seconds the smoke lasts. Unused cells are 0 or none.
